sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:160

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:160:1
items.html: In the evening prayer, when all the Mochin were cut off entirely, etc.: And there is also a great difference between the Shema of the evening prayer and the Shema upon the bed and the Shema of the sacrifices. For although all the Mochin of the day were cut off, nevertheless there still remains the surrounding lights of Ima of Katnut from the Mochin of the day, which are the discernment of the completeness of the vessels; and therefore there is no need here for the preparation of the first intercourse for the ascent of MAN of this Shema. As will be said further on, in the words of the ARI.
